entry.title: Roborock Qrevo Pro replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: Qrevo Pro keeps the all-rubber main brush. Roborock’s Pro page also says the same machine may be shown as Q Revo Pro.

entry.title: Roborock Qrevo MaxV replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: Qrevo MaxV is the Dock 2.0 machine with an all-rubber brush and lifting dual mops. It is not S8 MaxV Ultra, even when a dust-bag title prints both names.

entry.title: Roborock Qrevo S replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: Qrevo S is named by itself on the filter, mop cloth, main brush, and main-brush cover. Qrevo S Pro is a different Roborock page.

entry.title: Roborock Qrevo Plus replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: Qrevo Plus is printed on the filter, the mop cloth, the main brush, and the main-brush cover. The dock-bag title only says Qrevo Series.

entry.title: Dreame L10s Ultra replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: The original L10s Ultra kit page lists that one model and packs 6 mop pads. L10s Ultra Gen 2 is on a different kit, with 3 wash-free mop pads.

entry.title: Dreame L20 Ultra replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: Dreame’s L20 Ultra kit page names only the L20 Ultra. The dust bags are the piece it shares with original L10s Ultra.

entry.title: Dreame X30 Ultra replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: X30 Ultra is one name on a Dreame kit whose title leads with L40s Ultra AE, L40s Ultra CE, and L10s Ultra Gen2. That kit packs 3 wash-free mop pads.

entry.title: Dreame X40 Ultra replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: The official kit title is X40 Ultra/L40 Ultra. The compatibility line adds GoVac 508 and the kit packs 6 wash-free mop pads.

entry.title: Dreame L40 Ultra replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: Original L40 Ultra shares the X40 Ultra kit: 6 wash-free mop pads, plus GoVac 508. The label must not say Gen 2.

entry.title: Dreame L10s Ultra Gen 2 replacement-parts compatibility
entry.summary: Gen 2 has to be on the label. Dreame’s kit title leads with L40s Ultra AE, L40s Ultra CE, and L10s Ultra Gen2, and the kit packs 3 wash-free mop pads.
